name: Fairway for Orca
description: Choose an allowlisted Codex, Pi or Cursor profile with JEV, then explicitly launch it through Orca. Shadow mode by default.

settings.title: JEV requests
settings.description: Allow paid profile decisions. Selecting a profile never starts an agent.

settings.title: Explicit execution through Orca
settings.description: Enable the separate dispatch button for verified profiles.

settings.title: Total JEV budget, USD
settings.description: Cumulative decision reservation limit, 0–10 USD, up to 6 decimal places. Saving does not reset accounting.

settings.title: JEV attempt limit
settings.description: Cumulative limit, 0–100. Configure profiles and the key in the Fairway panel.
